name: task-tour-management-system
description: Tour Management System monorepo root: one-command install, test, lint and verification across the Express + MongoDB API and the React applications. See README.md.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix admin && npm ci --prefix tourcompanydashboard
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix frontend run test:ci && npm --prefix admin run test:ci && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run test:ci
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage && npm --prefix admin run test:coverage && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint && npm --prefix tourcompanydashboard run lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run lint:root && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:repo && npm test
